blocks.en: Mathematics is playing an ever more important role in the physical and biological sciences, provoking a blurring of boundaries between scientific disciplines and a resurgence of interest in the modern as well as the classical techniques of applied mathematics. This renewal of interest, both in research and teaching, has led to the establishment of the series Texts in Applied Mathematics (TAM).
blocks.zh: 数学在物理科学和生物科学中发挥着日益重要的作用, 促使各科学学科之间的界限变得模糊, 也使人们重新关注应用数学的现代技术和经典技术. 研究与教学中这种重新兴起的兴趣, 促成了 Texts in Applied Mathematics (TAM) 丛书的创立.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The development of new courses is a natural consequence of a high level of excitement on the research frontier as newer techniques, such as numerical and symbolic computer systems, dynamical systems, and chaos, mix with and reinforce the traditional methods of applied mathematics. Thus, the purpose of this textbook series is to meet the current and future needs of these advances and to encourage the teaching of new courses.
blocks.zh: 数值与符号计算机系统, 动力系统和混沌等较新的技术与应用数学的传统方法相互交融并增强后者, 使研究前沿充满活力, 而新课程的开设正是这一局面的自然结果. 因此, 本教材丛书旨在满足这些进展在当前及未来带来的需求, 并鼓励开设新课程.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: TAM will publish textbooks suitable for use in advanced undergraduate and beginning graduate courses, and will complement the Applied Mathematical Sciences (AMS) series, which will focus on advanced textbooks and research-level monographs.
blocks.zh: TAM 将出版适用于本科高年级和研究生初级课程的教材, 与 Applied Mathematical Sciences (AMS) 丛书相互补充; 后者将侧重于高级教材和研究性专著.

blocks.en: Partial differential equations are fundamental to the modeling of natural phenomena; they arise in every field of science. Consequently, the desire to understand the solutions of these equations has always had a prominent place in the efforts of mathematicians; it has inspired such diverse fields as complex function theory, functional analysis and algebraic topology. Like algebra, topology and rational mechanics, partial differential equations are a core area of mathematics.
blocks.zh: 偏微分方程是自然现象建模的基础; 它们出现在科学的各个领域. 因而, 理解这些方程的解这一愿望, 始终在数学家的努力中占有重要地位; 它推动了复变函数论, 泛函分析和代数拓扑等不同领域的发展. 与代数, 拓扑和理性力学一样, 偏微分方程是数学的核心领域.

blocks.en: Unfortunately, in the standard graduate curriculum, the subject is seldom taught with the same thoroughness as, say, algebra or integration theory. The present book is aimed at rectifying this situation. The goal of this course was to provide the background which is necessary to initiate work on a Ph.D. thesis in PDEs. The level of the book is aimed at beginning graduate students. Prerequisites include a truly advanced calculus course and basic complex variables. Lebesgue integration is needed only in Chapter~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations}, and the necessary tools from functional analysis are developed within the course.
blocks.zh: 遗憾的是, 在通常的研究生课程中, 这一学科很少像代数或积分论那样得到深入而系统的讲授. 本书旨在改变这一状况. 这门课程的目标, 是为开始从事 PDE 博士论文研究提供必要的背景. 本书的程度面向初入研究生阶段的学生. 预备知识包括一门真正的高等微积分课程和基本的复变函数知识. 只有 Chapter~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations} 需要 Lebesgue 积分, 而所需的泛函分析工具将在课程中介绍.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: The book can be used to teach a variety of different courses. Here at Virginia Tech, we have used it to teach a four-semester sequence, but (more often) for shorter courses covering specific topics. Students with some undergraduate exposure to PDEs can probably skip Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction}. Chapters~\ref{chap:characteristics}--\ref{chap:maximum-principles} are essentially independent of the rest and can be omitted or postponed if the goal is to learn functional analytic methods as quickly as possible. Only the basic definitions at the beginning of Chapter~\ref{chap:characteristics}, the Weierstrass approximation theorem and the Arzela-Ascoli theorem are necessary for subsequent chapters. Chapters~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations}, \ref{chap:energy-methods-evolution-problems} and \ref{chap:semigroup-methods} are independent of each other (except that Chapter~\ref{chap:semigroup-methods} uses some definitions from the beginning of Chapter~\ref{chap:energy-methods-evolution-problems}) and can be covered in any order desired.
blocks.zh: 本书可用于讲授各种不同的课程. 在 Virginia Tech, 我们曾用它讲授一个为期四学期的系列课程, 但更多时候用于讲授涵盖特定专题的较短课程. 本科阶段接触过一些 PDE 的学生, 大概可以跳过 Chapter~\ref{chap:introduction}. Chapters~\ref{chap:characteristics}--\ref{chap:maximum-principles} 基本上独立于其余部分; 如果目标是尽快学会泛函分析方法, 可以省去或推迟讲授这几章. 后续章节只需要 Chapter~\ref{chap:characteristics} 开头的基本定义, Weierstrass 逼近定理和 Arzela-Ascoli 定理. Chapters~\ref{chap:nonlinear-elliptic-equations}, \ref{chap:energy-methods-evolution-problems} 和 \ref{chap:semigroup-methods} 相互独立 (只是 Chapter~\ref{chap:semigroup-methods} 使用了 Chapter~\ref{chap:energy-methods-evolution-problems} 开头的一些定义), 可以按任何需要的顺序讲授.

blocks.en: We would like to thank the many readers of the first edition who provided comments and criticism. In writing the second edition we have, of course, taken the opportunity to make many corrections and small additions. We have also made the following more substantial changes.
blocks.zh: 感谢第一版的众多读者提供意见与批评. 在撰写第二版时, 我们当然借此机会作了许多修正和少量补充. 此外, 还作了以下较为实质性的改动.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en:
\begin{itemize}
\item We have added new problems and tried to arrange the problems in each section with the easiest problems first.
\item We have added several new examples in the sections on distributions and elliptic systems.
\item The material on Sobolev spaces has been rearranged, expanded, and placed in a separate chapter. Basic definitions, examples, and theorems appear at the beginning while technical lemmas are put off until the end. New examples and problems have been added.
\item We have added a new section on nonlinear variational problems with ``Young-measure'' solutions.
\item We have added an expanded reference section.
\end{itemize}
blocks.zh:
\begin{itemize}
\item 增加了新的习题, 并尝试将每节的习题按最容易的题目在前的顺序排列.
\item 在分布和椭圆方程组的各节中增加了几个新例子.
\item 关于 Sobolev 空间的内容经过重新编排和扩充, 并单独成为一章. 基本定义, 例子和定理放在开头, 技术性的引理则推迟到末尾. 还增加了新的例子和习题.
\item 新增了一节关于具有 ``Young-测度'' 解的非线性变分问题的内容.
\item 扩充了参考文献部分.
\end{itemize}
